tools.name: list_job_types
tools.description: Use this first when the user mentions a repair, replacement or recurring service at a US property. Returns the trade and job_type ids that request_quotes and check_fair_price need, plus prices. Free.

tools.name: request_quotes
tools.description: Use this when the user wants quotes or bids from local contractors for a real job at a US property, or wants to re-bid an annual service contract. We email licensed, well-reviewed local contractors, follow up, and return a ranked comparison, usually within 48 hours. Price: $39 per job in USDC over x

tools.name: get_quote_job
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how their contractor quote request is going. Returns status, contractors contacted and replied, and the ranked quotes so far for a job_token from request_quotes. Free.

tools.name: check_fair_price
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a contractor price or quote is fair, or what a job typically costs in their area (US). Compares against real quotes we collected for the same job type in the same 3-digit ZIP region. Returns the median, sample size and, if quoted_usd is given, a verdict (low, fair
